title: [2.7] All delta get set to 0 after 30s (Dexcom patched app and xDrip)
symptom: When using xDrip as source (with G6) the delta in homescreen is (almost always) 0 for all three deltas. The deltas get set to 0 exactly 30 seconds after the BG reading comes in. This also occurs when using the patched Dexcom app as source.
cause: The setup DEX -> AAPS -> XDRIP -> NS -> APPS causes data to be changed by xDrip in the middle of the chain, so it's not deduplicated on AAPS side, resulting in deltas of 0 for duplicate values.
fix: Disable all inter-app communication and upload settings in xDrip, and re-enable BG upload in AAPS. This stops duplicate uploads to Nightscout.
evidence_quote: Disabling all inter-app communication + upload settings in xdrip and then **re-enabling BG upload in AAPS** did the trick.
